title: kitfox-config dataset profile
description: Validates platform/dataset-profiles/{name}.yaml — snapshot tenant structure + restore sizing (§2.4b, Story A.5). The defaultTenant must be a member of tenants[]; that intra-file check is enforced by the validator (JSON Schema core cannot express cross-property containment).

infra.description: Restore sizing (§2.4b). NOTE: this is instance sizing, not topology — distinct from namespace.infra.

defaultTenant.description: The snapshot's default tenant; must be a member of tenants[] (validator intra-file check, A.5).

tenants.description: Catalog ids present in the snapshot (§2.4b).

consortia.description: Consortium membership for the dataset (same shape as namespace consortia, §2.4b).
